name: Savencia SA
summary: Savencia SA produces and distributes cheese and other dairy ingredients in France and internationally. It also offers butter, cream, sauces, and dairy desserts; desserts and preparations; cream cheese for cheesecakes; cheese for platters and sandwiches; cheese portions; cheese for culinary uses; dairy-based nutritional and functional ingredients; and cheese ingredients. The company provides butter and cream products for retail and food service sectors, as well as dairy ingredients for the food, infant formula, and pharmaceutical industries under the Elle & Vire, Corman, Caprice des Dieux, Saint Albray, Le Rustique, Cœur de Lion, Saint Agur, Bresse Bleu, St-Morêt, Tartare, Carré Frais, Apérivrais, Chavroux and Saint-Loup, RichesMonts raclette, Savencia Fromage & Dairy, Géramont, Saint Albray, Bresso, Milkana, Brunch, Lucina, Medve, Alouette, Polenghi, Král Sýru, Fol Epi, Liptov, and Balade brands. The company was formerly known as Bongrain SA and changed its name to Savencia SA in April 2015. Savencia SA is based in Viroflay, France.
